assumptions: GPU implementation (CubeCL kernels; crates/zensim-gpu). Default ZensimFeatureRegime::Basic: srgb->positive-XYB -> mirror pad -> 2x box downscale pyramid (4 scales) -> fused_features_kernel per (strip-block, strip, channel) -> host fold of 17 f64 + 3 peak partials -> 228-feature vector + MLP score (pipeline.rs:14-27).

fused_features_kernel is tile-fused: cooperative row loads into shared memory, 11-tap (DIAM=11, R=5) H-blur per row, sliding-window V-blur (subtract old + add new row), per-pixel SSIM + 17 moment accumulators + 3 peaks (fused.rs:83-88, 296-490). Shared-memory taps counted as load ops.
H-blur cost per output px: 11 taps for nm1/nm2 adds + 11 fma for nsq + 11 fma for ns12 + 4 INV_DIAM muls + 4 add/sub slide updates (fused.rs:420-460); cooperative row load ~2.3 loads/px x2 images.
Per-pixel feature body (fused.rs:296-365): ~8 flops ssim + mask mul, 4 mul sd moments, ~27 flops ed/artifact/detail block, ~13 flops vs/vd/pd block, 3 peak cmps.
XYB conversion uses Halley cbrtf_fast (color.rs:42+) ~30 flops + opsin mix ~15.
Extended regime (masked_iw_strip) is a separate opt-in path; not modelled (regime=Basic default, pipeline.rs:479-522).
